cues.en: So for the loop, this is why it's called a training loop.
cues.zh: for 迴圈，所以叫訓練迴圈，

cues.en: We step through a number of epochs.
cues.zh: 經過一定次數的 epochs，

cues.en: One epoch is a single forward pass through the data.
cues.zh: 一個 epoch，是資料的一次前向傳遞，

cues.en: So pass the data through the model for a number of epochs.
cues.zh: 所以把資料傳過模型，重複一定的 epoch 次數。

cues.en: Epochs is a hyper parameter, which means you could set it to 100, you could set it to 1000, you could set it to one, as we're going to see later on in this video.
cues.zh: epochs 是超參數，可以設 100、1000、1，像這支影片後面會看到，

cues.en: We skip this step with the colors, but we put the model in.
cues.zh: 顏色標示跳過這步，但模型要設成，

cues.en: We call model train.
cues.zh: 呼叫 model.train，

cues.en: This is the default mode that the model is in.
cues.zh: 這是模型預設模式。

cues.en: Essentially, it sets up a whole bunch of settings behind the scenes in our model parameters so that
cues.zh: 基本上，會在模型參數背後設定一大堆東西，

cues.en: they can track the gradients and do a whole bunch of learning behind the scenes with these functions down here.
cues.zh: 讓它們能追蹤梯度，透過下面這些函式學習，

cues.en: PyTorch does a lot of this for us.
cues.zh: PyTorch 替我們做很多事。

cues.en: So the next step is the forward pass.
cues.zh: 下一步前向傳遞，

cues.en: We perform a forward pass on the training data in the training loop.
cues.zh: 在訓練迴圈，對訓練資料做前向傳遞，

cues.en: This is an important note, and the training loop is where the model learns patterns on the training data.
cues.zh: 重要提醒，訓練迴圈，是模型從訓練資料學模式的地方，

cues.en: Whereas in the testing loop we haven't got to that yet is where we evaluate the patterns that our model has learned or the parameters that our model has learned on unseen data.
cues.zh: 測試迴圈還沒做到，是用沒見過的資料，評估模型學到的模式或參數。

cues.en: So we pass the data through the model.
cues.zh: 把資料傳過模型，

cues.en: This will perform the Ford method located within the model object.
cues.zh: 會執行模型物件裡的 forward 方法。

cues.en: So because we created a model object, you can actually call your models whatever you want, but it's good practice to you'll often see it just called model.
cues.zh: 因為建立了模型物件，其實想取什麼名都可以，但良好慣例，經常看到就叫 model。

cues.en: And if you remember, we'll go back to the code.
cues.zh: 記得，回程式碼，

cues.en: We created a Ford method in our model up here.
cues.zh: 上面模型裡建立了 forward 方法，

cues.en: Which is this?
cues.zh: 就是這個，

cues.en: Because our linear regression model class subclasses and not module, we need to create our own custom forward method.
cues.zh: 因為 LinearRegressionModel 類別繼承 nn.Module，需要自己的自訂 forward。

cues.en: So that's why it's called a forward pass is because not only does it while the technical term is forward propagation, So if we have a look at a neural network.
cues.zh: 所以叫前向傳遞，不只是因為，技術名稱是前向傳播，找張神經網路，

cues.en: Picture.
cues.zh: 圖片，

cues.en: Forward propagation just means going through the network from the input to the output.
cues.zh: 前向傳播，就是從輸入到輸出，走過網路。

cues.en: There's a thing called back propagation, which we're going to discuss in a second, which happens when we call lost stop backward, which is going backward through the model.
cues.zh: 也有反向傳播，等一下談，呼叫 loss.backward 時發生，反方向走過模型。

cues.en: But let's return to our colorful slide.
cues.zh: 回彩色投影片，

cues.en: We've done the Ford Pass call, the Ford method, which performs some calculation on the data we pass in.
cues.zh: 做了前向傳遞，呼叫 forward，對傳入資料進行某種計算，

cues.en: Next is we calculate the lost value, how wrong the model's predictions are, and this will depend on what loss function you use, what kind of predictions your model is outputting, and what kind of true
cues.zh: 下一步算損失值，模型預測有多錯，取決於用什麼損失函數、模型輸出什麼預測，以及有什麼真實

cues.en: values you have.
cues.zh: 數值，

cues.en: But that's what we're doing here.
cues.zh: 這就是這裡做的，

cues.en: We're comparing our model's predictions on the training data to what they should ideally be, and these will be the training labels.
cues.zh: 比較模型對訓練資料的預測，以及理想上應該是什麼，也就是訓練標籤。

cues.en: The next step, we zero the optimizer gradients.
cues.zh: 下一步，把最佳化器梯度歸零，

cues.en: So why don't we do this?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: Well, it's a little confusing for the first epoch in the loop, but as we get down to optimize it step
cues.zh: 第一次 epoch 有點混淆，但走到這裡的 optimizer.step，

cues.en: here, the gradients that the optimizer calculates accumulate over time so that for each epoch, for each loop step, we want them to go back to zero.
cues.zh: 最佳化器計算的梯度會隨時間累積，所以每個 epoch、每次迴圈，希望歸零。

cues.en: And now the exact reason behind why the optimizer accumulates gradients is buried somewhere within the PyTorch documentation.
cues.zh: 最佳化器為什麼累積梯度，確切原因藏在 PyTorch 文件某處，

cues.en: I'm not sure of the exact reason from memory.
cues.zh: 我不記得確切原因，

cues.en: It's because of compute optimization.
cues.zh: 好像是運算最佳化，

cues.en: It just adds them up in case you wanted to know what they were.
cues.zh: 只是把它們加起來，供需要時查看，

cues.en: But if you find out exactly, I'd love to know.
cues.zh: 但如果知道確切原因，很想聽。

cues.en: Next step is to perform back propagation on the loss function.
cues.zh: 下一步，對損失函數做反向傳播，

cues.en: That's what we're calling lost stop backward.
cues.zh: 就是呼叫 loss.backward，

cues.en: Now, back propagation is we compute the gradient of every parameter with requires grad equals true.
cues.zh: 反向傳播，計算每個 requires_grad=True 參數的梯度，

cues.en: And if you recall, we go back to our code.
cues.zh: 回想程式碼，

cues.en: We've set requires grad equals true for our parameters.
cues.zh: 我們替參數設定 requires_grad=True，

cues.en: Now the reason we've set requires Grad equals true is not only so that propagation can be performed on it.
cues.zh: 設定的原因，不只是讓它能執行反向傳播，

cues.en: But let me show you what the gradients look like.
cues.zh: 示範梯度長什麼樣，

cues.en: So let's go.
cues.zh: 所以查，

cues.en: Loss function curve.
cues.zh: 損失函數曲線，

cues.en: That's a good idea.
cues.zh: 好主意，

cues.en: So we're looking for some sort of convex curve here.
cues.zh: 找某種凸曲線，

cues.en: There we go.
cues.zh: 有了，

cues.en: L2 loss.
cues.zh: L2 loss，

cues.zh: 目前用 L1Loss，

cues.en: Is there a better one here?
cues.zh: 有更好的嗎？

cues.en: All we need is just a nice looking curve.
cues.zh: 只需要好看的曲線，

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 這裡，

cues.en: So.
cues.zh: 所以，

cues.en: This is why we keep track of the gradients behind the scenes.
cues.zh: 這就是在背後追蹤梯度的原因，

cues.en: Pied Torch is going to create some sort of curve for all of our parameters that looks like this.
cues.zh: PyTorch 會為所有參數，建立某種像這樣的曲線，

cues.en: Now, this is just a 2D plot.
cues.zh: 這只是二維圖，

cues.en: So the reason why we're just using an example from Google Images is, one, because you're going to spend a lot of your time Googling different things.
cues.zh: 用 Google 圖片例子，是因為第一，你會花很多時間搜尋不同東西，

cues.en: And two, in practice, when you have your own custom neural networks.
cues.zh: 第二，實務上有自己的自訂神經網路，

cues.en: Right now we only have two parameters, so it's quite easy to visualize a loss function curve like this.
cues.zh: 現在只有兩個參數，所以很容易視覺化這種損失曲線，

cues.en: But when you have, say, 10 million parameters, you basically can't visualize what's going on.
cues.zh: 但有一千萬參數時，基本上無法視覺化發生什麼，

cues.en: And so PyTorch, again, will take care of these things behind the scenes.
cues.zh: PyTorch 會在背後處理，

cues.en: But what it's doing is when we say requires grad PyTorch is going to track the gradients of each of our parameters.
cues.zh: 設 requires_grad 時，PyTorch 會追蹤每個參數的梯度，

cues.en: And so what we're trying to do here with back propagation and subsequently gradient descent is calculate
cues.zh: 這裡透過反向傳播，再梯度下降，想計算，

cues.en: where the lowest point is, because this is a loss function, this is MSI loss.
cues.zh: 最低點在哪裡，因為這是損失函數、MSE loss，

cues.en: We could trade this out to be mass loss in our case or one loss for our specific problem.
cues.zh: 可以換成這裡的 MAE loss，也就是 L1Loss，

cues.en: But this is some sort of parameter and we calculate the gradients because what is the gradient?
cues.zh: 這是某種參數，我們計算梯度，因為梯度是什麼？

cues.en: Let's have a look.
cues.zh: 看看，

cues.en: What is.
cues.zh: 什麼是，

cues.en: A gradient.
cues.zh: 梯度，

cues.en: A gradient is an incline part of a road or railway.
cues.zh: 梯度是道路或鐵路傾斜的部分，

cues.en: Now we want it in machine learning.
cues.zh: 但我們要機器學習，

cues.en: What's it going to give us in machine learning?
cues.zh: 機器學習會給什麼？

cues.en: A gradient is a derivative of a function that has more than one input variable.
cues.zh: 梯度，是具有超過一個輸入變數的函數的導數。

cues.en: Okay, let's dive in a little deeper.
cues.zh: 好，再深入，

cues.en: See, here's some beautiful lost landscapes we're trying to get to the bottom of here.
cues.zh: 看，漂亮的損失地形，試著走到底下，

cues.en: This is what gradient descent is all about.
cues.zh: 這就是梯度下降，

cues.en: So.
cues.zh: 所以，

cues.en: Oh, there we go.
cues.zh: 喔，有了，

cues.en: So this is a cost function, which is also a loss function.
cues.zh: 這是成本函數，也就是損失函數，

cues.en: We start with a random initial variable.
cues.zh: 從隨機初始變數開始，

cues.en: What have we done?
cues.zh: 我們做了什麼？

cues.en: We've started with a random initial variable, right?
cues.zh: 從隨機初始變數開始，對吧？

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好，

cues.en: And then we take a learning step.
cues.zh: 再走一個學習步驟，

cues.en: Beautiful.
cues.zh: 很好，

cues.en: This is w, so this could be our weight parameter.
cues.zh: 這是 w，所以可以是 weight 參數，

cues.en: Okay, we're connecting the dots here.
cues.zh: 把事情連起來了，

cues.en: This is exciting.
cues.zh: 好興奮，

cues.en: We've got a lot of tabs here, but that's all right.
cues.zh: 分頁很多，沒關係，

cues.en: And what we're trying to do is come to the minimum.

cues.en: Now, why do we need to calculate the gradients?
cues.zh: 為什麼要算梯度？

cues.en: Well, the gradient is what?
cues.zh: 梯度是什麼？

cues.en: Oh value of white.
cues.zh: 喔，weight 的值，

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 這裡，

cues.en: This is even better.
cues.zh: 更好了，

cues.en: I love Google Images.
cues.zh: 我喜歡 Google 圖片。

cues.en: So this is our loss and this is the value of a weight.
cues.zh: 這是損失，這是權重值，

cues.en: So we calculate the gradients.
cues.zh: 所以計算梯度，

cues.en: Why?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: Because the gradient is the slope of a line or the steepness.
cues.zh: 因為梯度是線的斜率或陡峭程度，

cues.en: And so if we calculate the gradient here and we find that it's really steep right up the top of this, this incline, we might head in the opposite direction to that gradient.
cues.zh: 計算這裡梯度，發現斜坡上方很陡，就往梯度的反方向，

cues.en: That's what gradient descent is.
cues.zh: 這就是梯度下降。

cues.en: And so if we go down here now, what are these step points is a little thing that I wrote down in the last video.
cues.zh: 往下看，這些步長，是上支影片寫的小東西，

cues.en: At the end of the last video I haven't told you about yet, but I was waiting for a moment like this.
cues.zh: 上支最後寫的，還沒講，正在等這種時機，

cues.en: And if you recall, I said kind of all of these three steps, optimize zero grade loss backward, optimize a step are all together.
cues.zh: 記得，這三步一起作用，optimizer.zero_grad、loss.backward、optimizer.step，

cues.en: So we calculate the gradients because we want to head in the opposite direction of that gradient to get to a gradient value of zero.
cues.zh: 計算梯度，是因為想往它反方向，走到梯度為 0 的地方，

cues.en: And if we get to a gradient value of zero with a loss function, well then the loss is also zero.
cues.zh: 損失函數梯度為 0，損失也就是 0，

cues.en: So that's why we keep track of the gradient with requires grad equals true.
cues.zh: 所以設定 requires_grad=True，追蹤梯度，

cues.en: And again, PyTorch does a lot of this behind the scenes.
cues.zh: 同樣，PyTorch 在背後做很多，

cues.en: And if you want to dig more into what's going on here, I'm going to show you some extra resources for back propagation, which is calculating this gradient curve here and gradient descent, which is finding
cues.zh: 如果想深入了解，這支最後會提供反向傳播的額外資源，計算這裡的梯度曲線，以及梯度下降，

cues.en: the bottom of it towards the end of this video.
cues.zh: 找到底部，

cues.en: And again, if we started over this side, we would just go in the opposite direction of this.
cues.zh: 如果從另一邊開始，同樣往相反方向，

cues.en: So maybe this is a positive gradient here and we just go in the opposite direction here.
cues.zh: 這裡也許是正梯度，就往這個反方向，

cues.en: We want to get to the bottom.
cues.zh: 想到底下，

cues.en: That is the main point of gradient descent.
cues.zh: 就是梯度下降主要重點。

cues.en: And so if we come back.
cues.zh: 回來，

cues.en: I said.
cues.zh: 我說，

cues.en: This keep this step size in mind here.
cues.zh: 記住這裡步長，

cues.en: If we come back to where we created our loss function and optimizer, I put a little tidbit here for the optimizer because we've written a lot of code and we haven't really discussed what's going on.
cues.zh: 回到損失函數與最佳化器的建立處，我為最佳化器加了一點，因為寫很多程式，還沒真正討論，

cues.en: But I like to do things on the fly as we need them.
cues.zh: 但我喜歡需要時即時介紹。

cues.en: So inside our optimizer we'll have a main two parameters which is params.
cues.zh: 最佳化器主要有兩個參數，其中 params，

cues.en: So the model parameters you'd like to optimize params equals model zero dot parameters in our case and
cues.zh: 要最佳化的模型參數，這裡是 params=model_0.parameters，

cues.en: PyTorch is going to create something similar to this curve, not visually but just mathematically behind the scenes for every parameter.
cues.zh: PyTorch 會在背後為每個參數，用數學建立類似曲線，不是視覺圖，

cues.en: Now this is a value of wait, so this would just be potentially the white parameter of our network.
cues.zh: 這是 weight 值，所以可能是網路的 weight 參數，

cues.en: But again, if you have 10 million parameters, there's no way you could just create all of these curves yourself.
cues.zh: 但如果有一千萬參數，不可能自己建立全部曲線。

cues.en: That's the beauty of PyTorch.
cues.zh: PyTorch 很棒，

cues.en: It's doing this behind the scenes through a mechanism called Torch Auto Grad, which is auto gradient calculation.
cues.zh: 透過 torch.autograd 機制，在背後做，就是自動梯度計算，

cues.en: And there's beautiful documentation on this.
cues.zh: 有很棒的文件，

cues.en: If you'd like to read more on how it works, please go through that.
cues.zh: 想多了解，請讀一讀，

cues.en: But essentially behind the scenes, it's doing a lot of this for us for each parameter.
cues.zh: 基本上，在背後為每個參數做很多這些事，

cues.en: That's the optimizer.
cues.zh: 這就是最佳化器。

cues.en: Then within the optimizer, once we've told it what parameters to optimize, we have the learning rate.
cues.zh: 告訴最佳化器要最佳化哪些參數後，還有學習率，

cues.en: So the learning rate is another type of parameter that defines how big or small the optimizer changes the parameters with each step.
cues.zh: 是另一種參數，定義最佳化器每步改變參數的幅度，

cues.en: So a small learning rate results in small changes, whereas a large learning rate is in large changes.
cues.zh: 學習率小，變動小；學習率大，變動大。

cues.en: And so if we look at this curve here, we might at the beginning start with large steps so we can get closer and closer to the bottom.
cues.zh: 看曲線，一開始可能走大步，越來越接近底部，

cues.en: But then as we get closer and closer to the bottom to prevent stepping over to this side of the curve, we might do smaller and smaller steps.
cues.zh: 但接近時，為了避免跨到另一邊，可能走越來越小的步。

cues.en: And the optimizer in PyTorch, there are optimizers that do that for us, but there is also another concept called learning rate scheduling.
cues.zh: PyTorch 有些最佳化器會替我們做，但還有另一個概念，學習率排程，

cues.en: Which is again, something if you would like to look up and do more.
